payer_name.rationale: BusinessNameLine1Txt under PayerName is the best single-field match for the payer's name, though the schema splits it into two lines (blueprint may need to split into BusinessNameLine1Txt and BusinessNameLine2Txt).

payer_tin.rationale: PayerEIN directly maps to the payer's taxpayer identification number printed on the form.

recipient_name.rationale: RecipientNm directly maps to the recipient's name box on the form.

recipient_tin.rationale: RecipientSSN is the best available match; the schema does not expose a separate RecipientEIN leaf for individuals, so SSN is the primary TIN field (RecipientEIN at idx 40 also exists for entities, but RecipientSSN is more common).

account_number.rationale: RecipientAccountNum directly maps to the account number box on the 1099-B.

description_of_property.rationale: PropertyDesc directly maps to Box 1a description of property sold or exchanged.

date_acquired.rationale: AcquiredDt directly maps to Box 1b date acquired.

date_sold.rationale: SoldOrDisposedDt directly maps to Box 1c date sold or disposed.

proceeds.rationale: ProceedsAmt directly maps to Box 1d gross proceeds.

cost_or_other_basis.rationale: CostOrOtherBasisAmt directly maps to Box 1e cost or other basis.

accrued_market_discount.rationale: AccruedMarketDiscountAmt directly maps to Box 1f accrued market discount.

wash_sale_loss_disallowed.rationale: NondeductibleWashSaleLossAmt directly maps to Box 1g wash-sale loss disallowed.

federal_income_tax_withheld.rationale: FederalIncomeTaxWithheldAmt directly maps to Box 4 federal income tax withheld.

term.rationale: Blueprint bundles short-term, long-term, and ordinary into a single category field, but the canonical schema splits these into three separate boolean indicators (ShortTermGainLossInd, LongTermGainLossInd, OrdinaryInd); blueprint should be refactored into three boolean fields matching those elements.

covered_security.rationale: NoncoveredSecurityInd is the inverse of covered_security (true here means non-covered); BasisReportedInd (idx 3) is also related but NoncoveredSecurityInd most directly reflects Box 3 covered/non-covered status.

applicable_checkbox_on_form_8949.rationale: Form8949ApplicableCheckboxCd directly maps to the Form 8949 reporting category code.

loss_not_allowed.rationale: LossNotAllowedInd directly maps to Box 5 loss-not-allowed checkbox.

collectible_or_qof.rationale: Blueprint bundles collectible (Box 6) and QOF (separate checkbox) into one boolean, but the canonical schema splits them into CollectiblesInd (idx 7) and QOFInd (idx 38); blueprint should be refactored into two separate boolean fields.

realized_gain_or_loss.rationale: No canonical element for net gain/loss exists in the IRS 1099-B MeF schema; this is a computed field common on broker substitute statements but not an IRS-defined XML element.

quantity.rationale: No canonical element for quantity/shares sold exists in the IRS 1099-B MeF schema; quantity is not a standard IRS-defined box and has no matching XSD element.

cusip.rationale: CUSIPNum directly maps to the CUSIP identifier field on the 1099-B.

bartering_income.rationale: BarterAmt directly maps to Box 13 barter exchange fair market value.

state_tax_withheld.rationale: StateTaxWithheldAmt under Form1099BStateLocalTaxGrp directly maps to Box 16 state income tax withheld.

state.rationale: StateAbbreviationCd under Form1099BStateLocalTaxGrp directly maps to Box 15 two-letter state abbreviation.

state_identification_number.rationale: StateIdNum under Form1099BStateLocalTaxGrp directly maps to Box 17 payer's state identification number.
